Video Outline

Concept

“Time Perspective” turns a simple talking-head monologue into a striking visual essay. We keep the original footage and audio, then layer clean, synchronized graphics that show how an 80-year life is really spent. With a minimalist style plus split-screens and fullscreen overlays, it builds a rhythmic flow that drives home how much time goes to the mundane, then pivots to a liberating message. Live intentionally, today.

Storyboard

00:00–00:17
VOICEOVER

“Here’s a statistic that puts life into perspective if you live to be eighty years old you’ll spend about twenty six years asleep another seven years trying to fall asleep around eleven years watching screens and roughly four to five years eating”

SCREEN DESCRIPTION

Lifespan Perspective

The speaker introduces the lifespan perspective statistic as the right graphic panel displays an elegant '80-YEAR LIFESPAN' headline. The speaker details sleeping habits while the right panel animates circular progress rings for sleep (26 years) and trying to sleep (7 years). The speaker details screen time and eating habits while the rings for screens (11 years) and eating (4.5 years) fill up on the right panel.

MATERIAL

Presenter Narration Bridge

80-Year Routine Breakdown

00:17–00:31
VOICEOVER

“That leaves surprisingly little time for everything else it sounds depressing but it’s actually liberating because life isn’t measured only by you because life isn’t measured only by years.”

SCREEN DESCRIPTION

The Emotional Pivot

The speaker begins talking about how little time is left for everything else as a cool, slate-blue transparent wash fades in over the full canvas and “DEPRESSING?” appears in large, elegant typography on the left. The transparent full-canvas wash transitions smoothly to a warm, glowing golden-amber tint as the speaker says “liberating” and “LIBERATING.” fades in on the right. The warm golden-amber wash and text fade out gracefully as the scene concludes, leaving the source video clean for the next shot.

MATERIAL

Depressing Reaction Card

Liberating Lifespan Reframe

00:31–00:45
VOICEOVER

“It’s measured by how intentionally you spend the hours you’re awake you don’t need thousands of perfect days you just need today’s twenty-four hours to count a little more than yesterday’s.”

SCREEN DESCRIPTION

Today's 24 Hours

The layout transitions via scale-pop to bottom-right PIP, and a minimalist 24-hour clock ring begins to draw in on the left graphic canvas. The clock ring shows a glowing gold arc representing “Awake & Intentional” hours, with large elegant text “AWAKE & INTENTIONAL” above it. The clock ring morphs into side-by-side comparison arcs for “YESTERDAY” (grey) and “TODAY” (glowing gold, slightly larger) with the final bold callout “MAKE TODAY COUNT” and the speaker smiling warmly in the PIP.
